_readme: The one source of every Vortex colour. scripts/build.mjs turns it into Sass variables (staff
register), dist/guildhall.css (player register), Kotlin and Dart; scripts/contrast.mjs checks it.
Each token has a light and a dark value, both literal hex. 'kotlin' is the name the self-help
app already uses for it (ParchmentColors.kt); 'note' says what it is for.

brand.note: Wordmark text, h1, identity. Never an action.

primary.note: Primary action: rust, calmer copper in dark mode.

primary-text.note: The primary as text: outline buttons, focus, emphasis.

secondary-button.note: Grey button; darker in dark mode so it never outshines the primary.

secondary-text.note: Grey as text and outline (btn-outline-secondary, text-secondary); lighter in dark mode.

danger.note: Destructive actions and errors as a fill, shared with the Guild Hall error colour.

danger-text.note: Errors as text and outline (text-danger, btn-outline-danger, validation messages).

success-text.note: text-success, btn-outline-success. Bootstrap's own green is 4.2:1 on a light surface; dark is Bootstrap's dark emphasis.

warning-text.note: text-warning, btn-outline-warning. Bootstrap's yellow is 1.5:1 as text on light; this is Guild Hall's warning amber.

info-text.note: text-info, btn-outline-info. Bootstrap's cyan is 1.9:1 as text on light; dark is Bootstrap's dark emphasis.

accent.note: Gilt. Non-text only: current-page bars, drop targets.

text.note: Guild Hall's ink: one text colour for every app.

text-emphasis.note: Bootstrap's emphasis colour (table text, th, text-body-emphasis). A warm near-white in dark mode: #fff glares next to the warm body text.

bg.note: Guild Hall's paper: the same page in every app (was white until 2.0.0).

raised.note: Cards, fields, menus and dialogs: Guild Hall's paper-raised, a shade off the page.

surface.note: Header-free surfaces: rails, table heads. Light is Guild Hall's paper-sunken.

surface-2.note: Hover and neutral badges, a step below the surface.

va-crest.note: Oxblood crest bar: the header of every Vortex app, both registers.

on-crest.note: Cream text on the crest bar.

on-crest-muted.note: Nav links on the crest bar.

pure-white.note: Text on crimson and action fills.

va-crimson.note: Brand crimson as a fill (tiles, seals). Not for buttons: that is va-action.

va-crimson-text.note: Brand crimson as text: headings, links.

va-action.note: Primary action, the same rust/copper as the staff tools.

va-action-text.note: The action colour as text: secondary buttons, focus, selection.

error.note: Error text. Was #930000, the brand crimson; now a red of its own.

error-fill.note: Error as a fill (a destructive button): stays deep in dark mode, where error text turns light.

en-willpower.note: Was oklch(0.58 0.12 78) #a17003, 4.0:1 on paper; now L 0.54 so it reads as text.
